data:text/html,<body><canvas id="c"></canvas><style>body{margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:black}</style><script>const t=c.getContext("2d");c.width=innerWidth,c.height=innerHeight;const e=t.getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height),h=e.data;!function(){for(let t=0;t<c.height;t++)for(let e=0;e<c.width;e++){const i=(e-c.width/2)/300,n=(t-c.height/2)/300;let o=0,g=0,a=0;for(;o*o+g*g<4&&a<100;){const t=2*o*g+n;o=o*o-g*g+i,g=t,a++}const d=100===a?0:255*a/100,r=4*(t*c.width+e);h[r+0]=d,h[r+1]=d,h[r+2]=d,h[r+3]=255}t.putImageData(e,0,0)}();</script></body>
